---
title: "Life Expectancy and Population"
---

This page explores the relationship between life expectancy and population size.

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv("gapminder.csv")

latest_year = df["year"].max()
sub = df[df["year"] == latest_year]

plt.figure()
plt.scatter(sub["population_millions"], sub["life_expectancy"], alpha=0.7)
plt.xlabel("Population (millions)")
plt.ylabel("Life Expectancy")
plt.title(f"Life Expectancy vs Population ({latest_year})")
plt.show()
```
